scope: Architecture classification identity, pagination and revision/withdrawal review

ARQVER:AC-ARQ-05: reads only on request and retains off-page pending counts without approval

evidence: Added SQL regression: an equivalent physical copy and layout-only revision retain the three candidate identities/current classifications, preserve original analyzed provenance and decision payloads, and leave IRs unchanged.
Homonymous interfaces from distinct roots remain distinct; missing identity is an unresolved issue rather than an ID minted during a read.
Global state counts include pending items outside the page/filter. Bounded summaries omit full contracts, detail is explicit, and completeness is not inferred from page length.
One semantic contract change requires review only for that candidate/affected fragment; a physical version change alone does not invalidate it. The prior analyzed contract and actor remain available.

Source deletion through the real REST route preserves promoted IR obligations and classification history, emits the semantic-change event, marks the source retired and keeps planning/delivery gates incomplete.
Conflicting adopted revisions remain unresolved with distinct digests; there is no name-based winner or silent promotion suggestion.
Frontend preserves off-page counts, current/analyzed contract provenance, retired IR obligations and stale-detail rejection; it does not present classification as admission approval.

tests.reused_witnesses: native-architecture-read-community1.xml and native-architecture-read-core1.xml on byte-identical main86; no repeat or new-count claim

limits: Transport authorization uses controlled principals; parity exercises the materialized MCP host and REST route, not a complete installed credential lifecycle.
Some lifecycle/fault scenarios intentionally seed raw states; no mutation gate is qualified solely by such setup.
Full start-transition criteria remain separate from read completeness.
No product/SPA modification or legacy conversion. Main86 closure remains applicable with eight zero budgets; no promotion or real-data operation.
